game_concept: A arcade set in The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring, towers along the town wall: the herald must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the town gate.
theme: The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring: towers along the town wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Watchtower Ring, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the town gate. Each round, a new banners challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of banners by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Watchtower Ring'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Watchtower Ring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 26 seconds.
